record.question:
Consider the following statements:
(i) President of India has given assent to the Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) (VB -G RAM G) Bill, 2025 marking a significant milestone in the transformation of rural employment policy.
(ii) The Viksit Bharat - G RAM G Act, 2025 replaces MGNREGA. The Bill was introduced in Lok Sabha on December 16, 2025 and was passed, two days later, on December 18, 2025. In Rajya Sabha, it was passed on December 19, 2025.
(iii) The employment guarantee is enhanced to 125 days per rural household, strengthening income security; but not shifted from Demand-Based Model to Normative Allocation Framework.
Which of the statements given above is/are wrong?
